```python
import pixeltable as px

# Create directory
px.create_dir("demo", ignore_errors=True)

# Create table with schema
table = px.create_table(
    "demo.films",
    {"title": px.String, "year": px.Int, "revenue": px.Float}
)

# Insert rows in a single call
table.insert([
    {"title": "Jaws", "year": 1975, "revenue": 470.7},
    {"title": "Alien", "year": 1979, "revenue": 184.7}
])
```
